Pi mal Daumen.et: Literally, “pi times thumb”. Compare similar Polish pi razy drzwi (literally “pi times door”) and pi razy oko (literally “pi times eye”).

Piment.et: Borrowed from French piment, from Spanish pimiento, from Latin pigmentum, hence doublet of Pigment.
